saw_lines: Lab grown buyers ask whether the stone is real first, then check the price against a mined diamond before they commit.
So the lab answer must sit in the first line of each ad, or buyers leave before they reach the price.
Your 65 Google creatives include 29 text ads, so the certified stone and buyback promise should open three new ones, with one line each on lab grown versus mined pricing.
ads_1: Lab grown explainer text ads leading with certified stone and lifetime buyback
